prose: Gary Marcus comments on reports of Jensen Huang's resignation and Colette Kress taking over temporarily. He credits Huang's role in shifting Nvidia from games toward AI, while arguing that conflicts, political exposure and financing dependencies made the situation dangerous. His judgments about blame and future industry effects are opinion; underlying allegations should not be treated as established merely because the commentary repeats them.
highlights: Commentary reports an interim leadership change
Marcus credits Nvidia's earlier strategic pivot
Circular financing is one of his concerns
Judgments about responsibility are the author's
Predictions about industry effects remain uncertain
